items.html: *And know that the three parts of Bina, which are Bina and the first Tevuna and the second Tevuna, are all a single Partzuf. It is found that when there was the first ibbur of ZA, who is then in the phase of three included within three as is known, it was in this first Tevuna, which is the first Hey of the name, since, as the three parts mentioned became a single Partzuf, this first Tevuna is found to be from the Chazeh downward of the whole of the Partzuf mentioned, and there is the place of the ibbur, which is the place of the belly, within which the fetus is born; but in the upper Bina there is no phase of pregnancy and ibbur.
